## Wave 2 Summary

This wave resolves the **pinnable observable-constraint scan** that the S117 W2 working-paper conflated with the **non-pinnable seed-selection MECHANISM** (the §VII.BL spectral-action CP/texture-selection, which stays an atlas-08 Q18b standing direction — NOT this gate). The piecewise S117 results never closed the JOINT question:

- **2-2** (`CF-S117-LEPTON-SEESAW-R-CHANNEL`): the angle-fixing shared-ε_LX texture drives `R = Δm²₃₂/Δm²₂₁ = 113.564` (OUT of the NuFIT 5.2 NO 3σ R-floor `[17, 66]`), while the bare diagonal M_D gives `R_bare = 31.576` (IN band). R is set by the bowtie SHAPE, not the Majorana SCALE (rescale-invariant).
- **2-5** (`CF-S117-UEL-FLAT-DIRECTION`): the charged-lepton rotation U_eL is a genuine FREE direction — the spectral action is flat over the U_eL orbit (`ΔS/S = 3.22e-15`, functional-independent: flat in both ζ-a₄ and cutoff-f*), by trace cyclicity (S depends on the mass spectrum only). Under-determination CONFIRMED on the U_eL axis.
- **2-3** (`CF-S117-SEESAW-RESONANCE-MR-SEARCH`): scanned the **M_R axis at FIXED U_eL** — a DIFFERENT axis; θ12 is M_R-invariant (rank-2 Y_1=0 wall).

**Neither** scanned the JOINT `{R ∈ [17,66] ∧ θ12,θ23,θ13 ∈ NuFIT-3σ}` admissibility over the **free U_eL/ε_LX texture family**. Gate 2-1 does this: at fixed charged-lepton masses + fixed Dirac singular values + fixed B-branch M_R, scan the texture-admissible family `(U_eL, V_DR)`; for each point compute `(R, sin²θ12, sin²θ23, sin²θ13)`; test whether the joint region is non-empty and measure its admissible-volume fraction.

The substrate content is a **factorization**: R is invariant under the charged-lepton left-rotation U_eL (an overall rotation `M_ν → V M_ν Vᵀ` leaves the seesaw singular values fixed), so R-band membership lives on the neutrino-Dirac orientation V_DR (relative to the near-degenerate M_R), while the three PMNS angles are reachable via the freely-absorbing U_eL. The joint region is therefore non-empty **by explicit construction** at the bare point (R_bare=31.576 ∈ band) combined with the observed-PMNS-matching charged-lepton rotation (S116 W2 STEP 3b proved `obs_pmns_reachable=True`, 3/3 angle slots). The expected verdict is PASS (under-determination survives the joint observational constraint); the genuine FAIL/INFO pathways and the quantitative admissible-volume measure are pre-registered below.

The leptonic CP phase / Jarlskog J is **EXCLUDED** from the joint box (real textures, δ_CP ∈ {0,π} ⇒ J=0 — the framework's standing prediction). The CP-sector under-determination is the separate §VII.BL / S117-W3-3 question, NOT this gate.

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The joint region {R in [17,66] AND sin^2 th12,th23,th13 in NuFIT 5.2 NO 3-sigma} is NON-EMPTY with positive
  admissible-volume measure — the constructive analytic witness lands all 4 slots (bare V_DR=I -> R_bare=31.576
  in band; U_eL=U_obs^dag -> 3 angles in 3-sigma) AND the MC free-family measure f_adm_free is positive
  (>= 10 hits over 2e6 Haar draws). SOLUTION SPACE: the texture under-determination (free U_eL/V_DR, the flat
  directions of S per 2-5) SURVIVES the joint observational constraint — the framework's lepton mixing+spectrum
  freedom is observationally COMPATIBLE with NuFIT but NOT predictive (the PMNS angles + R are reachable over a
  positive-measure free-texture orbit, not pinned to a unique value). Confirms atlas-08 Q18b "mixing
  under-determined both sectors" extends to the JOINT (R+angle) box; the seed-selection that WOULD pin a value
  is the separate non-pinnable §VII.BL standing direction, untouched by this gate.
FAIL_meaning: >
  The joint region is EMPTY — the constructive witness FAILS (R_bare not in [17,66], OR no texture-admissible
  U_eL places the 3 angles in 3-sigma) AND the MC free-family f_adm_free = 0. SOLUTION SPACE: joint over-constraint —
  the framework is MORE predictive than "under-determined": its texture-admissible family CANNOT simultaneously
  place R and the 3 angles in their 3-sigma boxes, so the shared-eps_LX R-overshoot (R_eps23=113.564) would be
  FUNDAMENTAL, not relievable by the free U_eL. This would CLOSE the under-determination reading and open a genuine
  framework-vs-NuFIT tension (escalate to an atlas-08 Q18b workshop).
INFO_meaning: >
  The joint region is non-empty (the constructive witness lands) BUT a thin sliver — the MC free-family measure
  f_adm_free is consistent with zero (< N_min_hits=10 over N_eval=2e6 => f_adm_free < 5e-6), OR a witness slot
  lands within edge_tol_frac=5% of a 3-sigma boundary (diagnostic, non-load-bearing per cross-pillar Level-3
  annotation discipline). SOLUTION SPACE: the freedom survives the joint box but the observational constraint
  substantially shrinks the admissible free-texture orbit — a QUANTIFIED partial-determination (the joint box
  bites hard but does not close).

  (MAP-A vs MAP-B), so the Dirac-Yukawa ratio Y3/Y2 (hence R_bare) is oscillation-anchored — R_bare in band is a
  CONSISTENCY of the spectrum channel with NuFIT, not a zero-free-parameter prediction. The substrate-FIRST
  content is the seesaw STRUCTURE + the bowtie M_R shape + the factorization (R is U_eL-invariant) + the
  flatness of the U_eL/V_DR orbit. The joint-admissibility verdict is a statement about the SHAPE of the
  compatible solution region, not a derived value.
```

### Split contingency (per the context "split candidates" note)

Single gate. If the 2e6-draw MC scan stalls or the joint fraction is below MC resolution, **split by axis** using the factorization (R is U_eL-invariant):

- **§W2-1a {R-channel membership}**: MC scan V_DR over O(3) at fixed input spectra; measure `f_R = P(R(V_DR) in [17,66])` and the reachable R-interval `[R_min, R_max]`. (Pure neutrino-Dirac orientation axis.)
- **§W2-1b {3-angle membership}**: MC scan U_eL over O(3) at the bare neutrino spectrum (U_nuL=I); measure `f_angle = P(3 angles in 3-sigma)` and confirm `obs_pmns_reachable`. (Pure charged-lepton free-rotation axis.)
- **Combine** by the analytic factorization: `f_adm_free ≈ f_R · f_angle` (independent axes); the joint box is non-empty iff `f_R > 0 ∧ f_angle > 0`. Each sub-gate gets its own gate-ID + verdict line; the wave-AND closeout reports the joint verdict.

## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

Wave 2 is **independent**: Wave 3 (gen-physicist; spectral-functional + WDW residuals — `CF-S118-LEMP-OQ4-VACUUM-FERMI-PIN`, `CF-S118-WDW-S0-ONGRID`) does NOT consume Wave 2 outputs (disjoint domains). No cross-wave compute dependency. The CF-S118-PMNS-JOINT-ADMISSIBILITY outcome routes at session-close per its verdict:

- **PASS** → atlas-08 Q18b freshness fold: "lepton mixing+spectrum under-determination survives the JOINT (R + 3-angle) NuFIT 3-sigma box; admissible-volume fraction f_adm_free = <value> ± CV; the seed-selection that would pin a value remains the non-pinnable §VII.BL standing direction." (Latest-synthesis-wins; no registry status downgrade — the under-determination reading is STRENGTHENED.)
- **FAIL** → escalate: a genuine framework-vs-NuFIT joint tension; route to an atlas-08 Q18b adversarial workshop (does the texture-admissibility restriction that empties the box reflect a real §VII.BL constraint, or an over-tight scan?). Capstone-hygiene Q3 check (PROVEN/CONDITIONAL/BROKEN/INFO) on any Q18b-citing capstone claim.
- **INFO** → log the quantified partial-determination (f_adm_free thin sliver) into atlas-08 Q18b; carry forward a tighter-resolution scan (larger N_eval or the §W2-1a/b axis split) only if leverage warrants.

In all cases the verdict + f_adm_free measure feed the §VII.BL seed-selection standing direction (which this gate FEEDS but does NOT resolve).
